Definition: feminine of G4541; a Samaritess, i.e. woman of Samaria:--of Samaria.
BiblicalUsage: Samaritan woman is a woman of Samaria. You find the name in John 4:9: "…being a Jew, askest drink of me, which…" — in the SBL text the word is spelled Σαμαρῖτις.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Samaritan woman matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
